source_definition_review: The native county report explicitly separates Ballots Cast and Registered Voters from all candidate/option selections and prints their county fraction. Every native participation unit sums to those separate county totals. This permits the source-defined reported county snapshot and its same-report registered fraction, not complete all-mode coverage, certification, final unique voters or population/demographic rates.
